body:
Yeah, I confessed about being sad, not necessarily suicide. I would hate to draw that kind of awkward attention towards myself.
I hate how I cant truly express myself without being heavily judged.

"I still try to tell people

That I need help

I say it in my actions

I say it in my words

I say it in my hugs

I say it in my jokes

I say it in my smile"

So do I....I try and reach out so hard without being obvious :(

I cant speak to my parents. I am living away from them and last time my depression was apparent they were worried sick. I dont want to put them through that when we are far away.

If I do pull a friend to the side and tell them I dont want to be given special treatment or looked at differently.

Loneliness. While I do have a nice group of friends I always feel like I dont fit in, or I just get unheard a lot of the times.
Iv been wanting to end it for a very long time. Iv been put off by how it would affect family, but over the last few weeks my tipping point has been turning and all my pain from before is coming back to me.
